::: {.method-meta}
[Metabolomics correlation]{.area} [released]{.status .released} [Python]{.badge-p} [GNPS]{.badge-p .planned} [R]{.badge-p .planned}
:::

MetVAE constructs a correlation network from untargeted metabolomics data. A variational autoencoder imputes values below the detection limit, covariate effects are removed, and a sparse correlation matrix between metabolite features is estimated.

## Platforms

| Platform | Package | Install | Documentation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Python | metvae (PyPI), with the command-line tool `metvae-cli` | `pip install metvae` | [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/metvae/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/FrederickHuangLin/MetVAE-PyPI) |
| GNPS | GNPS_Local, an offline single-user version of GNPS molecular networking | In development | [Integration branch](https://github.com/ziluwang829/GNPS_Local/tree/metvae-integration) · [GNPS_Local](https://github.com/Some-Earth-2514/GNPS_Local) |
| R | R package | In development | |

## Quick start

```bash
pip install metvae
metvae-cli --help
```

The Python interface and a worked example are described on the [PyPI project page](https://pypi.org/project/metvae/).

## Citation

Lin H, Zhang L, Lotfi A, Jarmusch A, Lee I, Kim A, Morton JT, Aksenov A. Protocol for constructing correlation-based molecular networks from large-scale untargeted metabolomics data. *bioRxiv* (2026). [doi:10.1101/2025.04.26.649581](https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.04.26.649581)
